dinomischus.name: Dinomischus whole-organism bract-crowned reconstruction
dinomischus.purpose: Whole-organism evidence-informed Dinomischus isolatus-style reconstruction. Cup, slender stem, bulbous holdfast and20 bracts retained. Genus-level asset with named source morphology, not a fossil replica or settled phylogenetic placement.
dinomischus.scale: Nominal total height28mm follows ROM maximum size; inferred cup width9mm and living depth illustrative, not all specimens this size.
dinomischus.decisions: Concept upright stalk, bulb and crown adopted. Concept tips spread like a flower and vary counts between views: reject that inconsistency, freeze exactly20 flattened stiff bracts leaning only8degrees outward, each4.2mm long. Cup upper disc shallow, two small openings are deliberately subtle interpretations of proposed mouth/anus, not eyes. Long16mm slender rigid stem joins bulb below and tapered calyx above. Whole organism, no missing hidden half. Affinity unknown; no tentacles, leaves, crinoid arms or guts. Bulb underbody atz0, muted buff coloration purely artistic. Twenty bracts spaced evenly with narrow gaps and rounded ends, flattened radial thickness, not cylinders.
features: Complete whole organism with bulbous basal termination and long slender rigid stem
Cup-shaped calyx with exactly20 stiff upright flattened bracts around upper rim
Bracts extend above shallow upper surface; no animal face, leaves or feather arms
Affinity unknown; hidden anatomy, palette and living posture inferred

source.title: Royal Ontario Museum Burgess Shale: Dinomischus isolatus

source.notes: Morphology section supports cup calyx,long rigid stem,bulb termination and20 bracts up to4.5mm. Maximum size28mm. Full actual reconstruction image and thumbnail USNM198735 fossil pixels inspected before concept; reconstruction by Marianne Collins is interpretative, not photo of living animal.

star-dune.name: Star dune multi-ridge landform
star-dune.purpose: Generic full-volume star dune teaching asset, five unequal ridges descending from common summit and concave inter-arm saddles. Not a measured Great Sand Dunes replica.
star-dune.scale: Illustrative nominal dune envelope400m by320m by100m, not derived from photo or named dune measurements.
star-dune.decisions: Concept five radiating sharp connected ridges and concave saddles adopted; reject decorative perfect star footprint and exaggerated razor thin disconnected ends. Freeze one closed mound, five unequal bending arms, common100m summit,400m X by320m Y nominal apron;24angular subdivisions per arm and18radial rings, sharp crest-aligned samples and quiet slopes. Sand extends into gentle irregular interarm bays not a geometric pentagram. Wind directions not shown; both sides coherent. No terrain stand or vegetation. Hidden underside flat atz0. Palette broad directional surface regions, no noise or texture.
features: At least three ridges, here exactly five, descend from one dominant summit
Unequal curved arms and concave inter-ridge saddles visible overhead
Full volume sand mound with sloping quiet aprons, not a barchan crescent
Generic dune, no named locality replica or measured elevation claim

slot-canyon.name: Slot canyon open segment
slot-canyon.purpose: Generic three-dimensional erosional sandstone slot canyon segment with narrow continuous sinuous passage and paired high sculpted walls. Cropped section boundaries deliberate, not a whole named canyon replica.
slot-canyon.scale: Illustrative14m width28m length12m height; channel width1.7-2.3m. Dimensions not surveyed from Sheets Gulch or any site.
slot-canyon.decisions: Concept actual top and side labels swapped: resolve canonical top aszdown, side+X. Adopt opposed fluted walls and winding throat, reject stepped amphitheater-like widening and interior rubble. Freeze28m long Y-axis open passage,12m walls,1.7-2.3m throat with smooth S-bend and inward bulges; outer crop boundaries14m wide closed solid, flat underside and sandy floor. Wall bands coherent, large/medium flutes, no repeated equal steps or blocks. Front and rear open, no roof/arch/bridge. Generic form informed by actual Sheets Gulch photo not copying its shape, no named-site geology, period or flood forecast asserted.
features: Continuous narrow S-shaped passage open at both ends and sky
Two high opposed steep walls much taller than throat width
Eroded fluted inward walls with coherent strata and sandy dry channel floor
Explicit illustrative cropped segment, not a complete named canyon or arch

flowstone-cascade.name: Flowstone mineral cascade
flowstone-cascade.purpose: Generic cave flowstone cascade teaching asset: connected calcite sheet over three uneven host-rock ledges, rounded lobes and fluted lips. Solid mineral deposit, not flowing water, ice or exact named specimen.
flowstone-cascade.scale: Illustrative4m wide3m deep3.5m height; generic cave deposit, not measured Lechuguilla specimen dimensions.
flowstone-cascade.decisions: Concept three draped ledges, connected ivory sheet and rounded tongues adopted. Reject dense microtexture, icicle forest, plus concept larger than brief pendant count; freeze broad quiet calcite body following three uneven host-rock steps, about18low rounded lip tongues total grouped at two lips, not thin sharp stalactites. Upper bulb and lower fan apron connected along continuous fluted channels. Hidden back and sides solid host-rock volume with modest exposed margin, no floating curtain planes. Three ledge elevations nominal.9,1.85,2.85m with top3.5m. Six broad coherent deposition bands selected with surface material regions, not painted liquid streaks; no water, vegetation or cave room.
features: Connected solid mineral sheet cascading over three uneven host-rock ledges
Rounded calcite lobes and downward fluting with two pendant-bearing ledge lips
Broad spreading basal apron and real host-backed side/rear volume
Generic carbonate deposition illustration, not a liquid waterfall or named-site replica
